preconditions.description: Both numerator and denominator must be integers.
Numerator and denominator are within the range [1, 2000].

postconditions.description: The return value must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == str(numerator // denominator) if numerator % denominator == 0 else (str(numerator // denominator) + '.' + (fractional_part := (return_value.split('.')[1] if '.' in return_value else '')))
postconditions.description: If the fraction is an integer, the output is the integer string; otherwise, it contains an integer part, a decimal point, and a fractional part.

postconditions.expression: not ('(' in return_value and ')' not in return_value) and not (')' in return_value and '(' not in return_value)
postconditions.description: Parentheses for repeating parts must appear in matching pairs if present.
There is at most one repeating block enclosed in parentheses.

postconditions.expression: return_value == str(numerator // denominator) + '.' + (return_value.split('.')[1]) if '.' in return_value else return_value == str(numerator // denominator)
postconditions.description: The integer part of the string matches the integer division of numerator by denominator.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c in '.()-' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The string contains only digits, decimal point, parentheses, and a leading minus sign if applicable (though inputs are positive).
